name: Moroccan Legal Document Processing Pipeline
description: Collects Moroccan legal documents (laws, codes, Dahirs, Maroums) from adala.ma, extracts articles, and generates Q&A pairs using Google Gemini 2.5 Pro

options.systemMessage: You are a legal expert specialized in Moroccan law. For each article provided, generate exactly 4 question-answer pairs in valid JSONL format. Each line must be a valid JSON object with 'question' and 'answer' keys. Focus on practical understanding and application of the law.
